statement: (let rad := fun (n : ℕ) => n.primeFactors.prod id; let r := fun (a b : ℕ) => Real.log (rad (a*b*(a+b))); ∀ l : ℕ, l.Prime → 7 ≤ l → ∃ K : ℝ, ∀ a b : ℕ, 0<a → 0<b → Nat.Coprime a b → Real.log (16*((a:ℝ)^2+a*b+(b:ℝ)^2))/2 ≤ (1+4*(l:ℝ)/(((l:ℝ)-3)*(l+1)))*r a b+K) → (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ l : ℕ, l.Prime ∧ 7 ≤ l ∧ 4*(l:ℝ)/(((l:ℝ)-3)*(l+1)) ≤ ε) → (let h := fun (a b : ℕ) => Real.log ((a:ℝ)+b); ∀ a b : ℕ, 0 < a → 0 < b → 2*h a b + Real.log 12 ≤ Real.log (16*((a:ℝ)^2+a*b+(b:ℝ)^2))) → (let rad := fun (n : ℕ) => n.primeFactors.prod id; let h := fun (a b : ℕ) => Real.log ((a:ℝ)+b); let r := fun (a b : ℕ) => Real.log (rad (a*b*(a+b))); ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ a b : ℕ, 0<a → 0<b → Nat.Coprime a b → h a b ≤ (1+ε)*r a b+C)
